senses.gloss: चय् vt. 1Ā (pres. चयते) To go to or towards, to move.
चाय् vt. 1U (pres. चायति-ते) 1. To observe, to discern; 2. to worship.

चय m. 1. An assemblage, a multitude, a heap, a mass, अलिनीजिष्णुः कचानां चयः Bhartr.i.5, कुसुमचयरचितशुचिवासगेहे Git.G.xi., स्फुरति चानुवनं चमरीचयः Sis.iv.60; 2. a mound of earth raised to form the foundation of a building; 3. a mound of earth raised from a ditch; 4. a rampart; 5. the gate of a fort; 6. a seat, a stool; 7. gathering flowers &c.
चयन n. 1. The act of collecting (especially flowers &c.); 2. piling, heaping.
